text:
Ravi: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for 1758889500. Two recurring patterns: (1) midnight memory climb leading to p99 tail latency around 00:30 UTC, (2) mid-afternoon throughput plateau that trips queue-depth alerts. We need SLO tweaks + owners.
Zoe: I'll own dashboarding and anomaly alerts. Will add p50/p95/p99 by node-pool + model.
Lena: Proposal: make p99 SLO for interactive endpoints 450ms global, with a daytime tighter window 320ms 08:00-20:00 UTC. Also add an availability SLO for batch ingestion of 99.5% per 24h.
Carlos: For the memory issue I think we should gate autoscaler aggressive scale-down and add a node memory watermark at 70% to stop shedding pods. I'll propose HPA/cluster-autoscaler changes.
Marta: I'll write a short runbook for the midnight spike: steps to check heap growth, restart sequence, and where to collect profiling snapshots.
Zoe: Sample PromQL for p99 by pool: ```histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le,node_pool))``` And heatmap by hour to correlate memory RSS.
Ravi: Owners and deadlines suggestion: 1) Dashboards & alerts (Zoe) EOD Fri 2024-05-03, 2) SLO config + customer note (Lena) Mon 2024-05-06, 3) Autoscaler & HPA tweaks (Carlos) Wed 2024-05-08, 4) Midnight runbook + profiling job (Marta) Thu 2024-05-09.
Carlos: I can also add an autoscaler annotation to surface last-scale events into Grafana so we can see correlation.
Lena: On error-budget policy: suggest rolling-window burn-rate triggers. If burn-rate > 2x for 30m then trigger throttling of non-interactive batch and enable emergency capacity. This should be codified in the SLO policy doc.
Zoe: I'll add an "active mitigations" panel that lists throttles/fallbacks and their traffic percent as Emily asked in the prior thread.
Marta: For profiling I'll add a short script to capture pmap and jmap at 00:25 and upload to the artifacts bucket. Will include retention notes.
Ravi: Quick cost note: Carlos pls quantify extra buffer nodes cost if we keep a warm pool overnight. If it's small we can buy latency stability.
Carlos: Will estimate and post a number here by Tue.
pagerbot: INCIDENT NOTICE: Incident 1758889500 resolved. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1758889500. Follow-ups assigned.
Zoe: Created dashboard stub: https://grafana.redwood/d/slo/1758889999-midnight-memory - will push JSON and link Jira.
Lena: I'll draft the customer-facing SLA blurb explaining the time-window SLOs and share for review by Mon.
Ravi: Let's meet Fri 2024-05-03 15:00 UTC to confirm dashboards and initial burn-rate telemetry. If blockers pop up, drop short updates here.
Marta: Adding Jira tickets now and linking runbook PR to this thread.
Carlos: PR for autoscaler cooldown and memory watermark incoming, linking shortly.
Ravi: Thanks all. Closing thread, detailed execution in Jira but ping here for quick syncs.
